title: Deploying Tiny LVLM Judges for Real-World Evaluation of Chart Models: Lessons Learned and Best Practices
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical evaluation of chart comprehension models using Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). It measures performance through metrics like factual correctness and informativeness. While it includes a brief 'Ethical Statements' section regarding model usage and licensing, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
